C1023.title: Classroom Candid Photo Turned Porn: High School Teacher Stripped by AI—South Korea’s Sexual Crime 2.0
C1023.summary: Since 2021, South Korea has seen digital sex crimes in which AI deepfake technology was used to synthesize women photos into nude or pornographic content. The source supports the Seoul National University deepfake sex crime case, Telegram distribution, and 2024 investigation, with at least 61 known victims. Such cases show that public photos, social account materials, and generative image tools can significantly amplify privacy violations and sexual extortion risks.
